guide.title: Observe
guide.body: Uplands in the north catch more rain. Water flows by hydraulic head down the valley into the basin. Toggle overlays for surface water, soil moisture, temperature and vegetation. Select a cell to see its accepted water budget.

guide.title: Reduce upstream rain
guide.body: Open the law editor, select 'Rainfall' and insert a regional multiplier using the 'upstream' region, or duplicate the rule and scope it. Apply it at the next tick boundary. Run at 10x and watch the river's budget: inflow from the catchment falls below evaporation and infiltration.

guide.title: Restore and compare
guide.body: Branch from your checkpoint and restore rainfall in one branch. Compare water budgets, vegetation and population between branches. Recovery depends on surviving vegetation and groundwater, not on a scripted switch.

guide.title: Change a biological law
guide.body: Edit the metabolism or water-balance rule so heat raises water demand more steeply. Organisms with different inherited water conservation and thermal tolerance experience different costs. Watch the lineage panel's trait distributions over time.
